values.note: Reserve by calling the town office, 607-535-9476. A 1-night non-refundable deposit for a 1-6 night stay, 3 nights for 7-14 nights. No seasonal sites.

booking.source: https://www.townofmontour.gov/havanaglen ('Call the office at 607-535-9476 to make your reservation!'; 'A 1-night non-refundable deposit is required for a 1-night to 6-night stay'; 'A 3-night non-refundable deposit is required for a 7-night to 14-night stay'; 'We do not offer any seasonal sites'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.townofmontour.gov/havanaglen ('RV Sites – 14 sites (numbered C1 thru C14) $35 per night - 90lb water pressure - 30amp electric'), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://www.townofmontour.gov/havanaglen ('RV Sites – 14 sites (numbered C1 thru C14)'; 'Tent Sites – 10 sites (numbered T1-T10)'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.townofmontour.gov/havanaglen ('Dump Station Fee: $10 for non-campers / Free for Havana Glen campers'), read 2026-10-21

note: Town of Montour municipal park with the Eagle Cliff Falls swimming area. 14 RV sites and 10 tent sites. May-Oct. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the town's Havana Glen page: $35/night RV site ($210 for 7 nights; fees as read 2026-10-10), 14 RV sites (30-amp + water) and 10 tent sites, dump (free for campers), phone reservations at 607-535-9476. Added deposit rules and no seasonal sites. Note trimmed of hookup/dump/booking text. Not stated: season dates (the page says only that the park is closed for 2026 and taking 2027 reservations), site lengths.
